name: Plain text accounting
description: hledger, Ledger and Beancount journals in Kalem: checked, reported, reconciled, imported and priced by the tool you already have, completed by their language servers

menus.title: Journal
menus.when: textType == hledger || textType == journal || textType == j || textType == ledger || textType == ldg || textType == beancount || textType == bean || textType == pta-check || textType == pta-balance || textType == pta-register || textType == pta-reconcile || textType == pta-import || textType == pta-report

buttons.title: Journal
buttons.when: textType == hledger || textType == journal || textType == j || textType == ledger || textType == ldg || textType == beancount || textType == bean || textType == pta-check || textType == pta-balance || textType == pta-register || textType == pta-reconcile || textType == pta-import || textType == pta-report

hledger-lsp.name: hledger-lsp
hledger-lsp.install: npm install -g hledger-lsp; or juev's, in the plugin's README

beancount-language-server.name: beancount-language-server
beancount-language-server.install: brew install beancount-language-server, or cargo install it

journal.description: The main journal, the one that includes the others: a path, absolute, from ~/, or beside the file; empty for the journal LEDGER_FILE names when it includes the file (hledger), or beancount-language-server's journal_file (Beancount), else the file itself

tool.description: The program that reads hledger's and Ledger's journals: auto for the file's own (a .ledger file is Ledger's where Ledger is installed, else hledger's), or one of them; a Beancount journal is always Beancount's

amount_column.description: Align Amounts (SPC m a) puts the amounts' last digits at this column, as ledger-mode does; 0 for as near the accounts as the longest posting allows

align_on_enter.description: Enter on a posting aligns its amount first, as ledger-mode does (not in Vim's insert mode, where SPC m a in normal mode does it)

check_on_save.description: Check the main journal with its tool each time a journal is saved: the status bar item shows ✓ or the problems' count, and the Check document, when open, is written again

checks.description: hledger's checks added to hledger check --strict: ordereddates, payees, recentassertions, tags, uniqueleafnames (hledger's own names; Ledger and Beancount have none)

insert_at.description: Where New Transaction and Copy Transaction write: at the date's place (after the last transaction dated on or before it), or at the end of the journal

toggle_postings.description: Toggle Status on a posting line marks that posting (as ledger-mode's), not its transaction

rules.description: hledger's rules for importing bank statements, when not the statement's own beside it (statement.csv.rules): a path, absolute or beside the statement

ledger_account.description: Ledger's import (ledger convert): the account a statement's lines are posted to, such as Assets:Checking

ledger_date_format.description: Ledger's import: how a statement writes its dates, empty for Ledger's own guess

examples: Cash: SELECT account, sum(position) WHERE account ~ 'Cash' GROUP BY account
reports.description: Reports of your own, first in Report… (SPC m o): NAME: ARGUMENTS, the tool's arguments after the journal's (hledger balance expenses -M), or a Beancount query

prices.description: Where Fetch Prices writes: a file the main journal includes, absolute or beside the main journal; empty for the main journal itself

price_sources.description: hledger and Ledger: the prices Fetch Prices asks pricehist for, as SOURCE BASE/QUOTE, a third word when the journal writes the quote otherwise ($ for USD); Beancount's come from its commodities' price: metadata

programs.hledger.description: Where hledger is, when it is not the one on the PATH: a full path; empty for the PATH's

programs.ledger.description: Where Ledger is, when it is not the one on the PATH: a full path; empty for the PATH's

programs.bean-check.description: Where Beancount's bean-check is (a virtual environment's bin, say), when it is not the one on the PATH; empty for the PATH's

programs.bean-query.description: Where Beancount's bean-query is, when it is not the one on the PATH; empty for the PATH's

programs.pricehist.description: Where pricehist is (Fetch Prices for hledger and Ledger), when it is not the one on the PATH; empty for the PATH's

programs.bean-price.description: Where Beancount's bean-price is (Fetch Prices), when it is not the one on the PATH; empty for the PATH's

servers.beancount-language-server.initia.description: Beancount's main journal, which beancount-language-server checks and completes from (absolute, from ~/, or beside the file), and the plugin too when journal is empty; empty for the file itself, which checked alone reports the accounts of the other files unknown

servers.hledger-lsp.ignore.description: What of hledger-lsp Kalem leaves unused: its formatting, since ptimoney's 0.7.0 formats a journal into one that means something else; [] for juev's, whose formatting hledger reads as before

settings.hledgerLanguageServer.maxNumber.description: hledger-lsp (ptimoney's): the most problems shown for a file

settings.hledgerLanguageServer.validatio.description: hledger-lsp (ptimoney's): warn of an account used but not declared with account (it takes an automated posting's virtual account, (budget:food), for undeclared; hledger does not)
hledger-lsp (ptimoney's): warn of a transaction dated after today (scheduled ones, too)
hledger-lsp (ptimoney's): warn of transactions out of date order

settings.hledgerLanguageServer.completio.description: hledger-lsp (ptimoney's): complete only the accounts declared with account; off for those used too

settings.hledger.diagnostics.accountChec.description: hledger-lsp (juev's): check that accounts are declared: off, lint (a soft check), or strict (as hledger --strict)

settings.hledger.diagnostics.undeclaredC.description: hledger-lsp (juev's): report an amount whose commodity is not declared (hledger asks it under --strict only)

settings.hledger.completion.accountScope.description: hledger-lsp (juev's): complete only the accounts with a balance (nonzero), or all, closed and unused ones too
